name: Uqua: Ritual Chambers
summary: Arcane chambers where ancient oceanic rites were performed, now destabilized by Discord corruption and planar water surges.
description: The Ritual Chambers of Uqua were once the sacred heart of the Ocean God’s worship. Here, priests conducted rites to bind oceanic planar energy, stabilize tidal flows, and commune with the deity. Discord ruptures have twisted these chambers, corrupting ritual circles and destabilizing water conduits. Water rises and falls unpredictably, forming spirals and collapsing into voids. Muramite forces attempt to disrupt the rites, while Ocean Cult ritualists fight desperately to maintain control. Discord manifestations erupt from failed rituals, turning the chambers into a volatile battleground of magic, water, and planar instability.
